The full exact pass took 13.526 s versus 28.908 s clean, with both including resolution and compilation. The cold pass took 39.526 s.

All six Wire configurations matched clean recomputation. The equal-scope word encoding improved both measured Eclipse attempts, including original JVM witness handling, and both encodings left the monolithic importer open. Six successful verification jobs and the superseded HTTP-driver failure are accounted for. The machine-readable evaluation and the qualified portfolio both pass their recounts, the published organic scorecard reproduces byte for byte, the changed-test selections passed, and the local evidence links resolve.
